format: PNG RGB + JSONL metadata + NumPy NPZ (not a LeRobot container)
source: MuJoCo kinematic simulation; no hardware measurements
state_semantics: actual current MuJoCo A/B/C task position before applying action
action_semantics: next commanded absolute A/B/C task position after trajectory/rate constraints; not final mission goal
timestamp_semantics: simulation seconds since episode start; intervals may be shorter at planner/phase endpoints
image_semantics: raw eye_internal RGB, same render groups as visual controller; no crosshair overlay or synthetic occlusion
visibility_semantics: Per-frame counts from physical MuJoCo segmentation. Needle-caused occlusion is measured with a diagnostic render that temporarily hides needle geoms; this counterfactual is offline metadata only and is never passed to navigation/control. No synthetic noise or pasted masks are used.
perception_semantics: Audit-only measurement provenance and controller state. target_observed distinguishes a current-frame target measurement from memory or unknown data. control_frame_index identifies the controller observation behind an exported row; occlusion_event_id associates controlled occlusion events with their audit records. true_position_error_um is independent evaluation and must not enter controller feedback or policy inputs.
target_memory_scope: A cached target, when used by a controller, assumes a calibrated stationary target and is not a current-frame observation. cached_target_age_s records time since observation; exporting these fields alone does not validate occlusion recovery, moving targets, or hardware performance. Consult the per-run protocol and result for the tested memory limits.

policy_interface.goal_coordinate_visibility: target coordinates and target IDs are absent from task text
policy_interface.image_loading: Decode paths relative to dataset root into RGB pixels; never tokenize paths or use filenames as features
policy_interface.audit_bundle: data/episode_*.npz and JSONL contain additional diagnostic labels; do not use those columns as policy features

alignment: image and state at timestamp t precede action; action equals next frame state within float32 tolerance
terminal_action: hold current position; does not establish hardware braking behavior

phase.meaning: phase of the outgoing action: retract, transfer, approach, visual_servo, or hold

visibility.known.meaning: false when segmentation was unavailable; remaining fields use unknown sentinels

visibility.target_occlusion_fraction_by_.undefined_when: unoccluded target pixel count is zero; JSONL stores null

visibility.counterfactual_no_needle_rend.meaning: true when a second diagnostic segmentation hid needle geoms

perception.target_source.meaning: controller-declared source of target position, such as current observation or stationary-target memory

perception.control_frame_index.meaning: source controller observation index; distinct from the exported dataset frame_index

perception.occlusion_event_id.meaning: occlusion fixture event identity for audit correlation; not a policy feature

perception.true_position_error_um.meaning: evaluation only; not controller or policy input

perception.target_observed.meaning: true only when the controller reports a valid current-frame target measurement

visibility_summary.source: MuJoCo geometry segmentation; offline no-needle counterfactual, not controller input

target_success_by_visibility.success_definition: endpoint result PASS and terminal stop validated
target_success_by_visibility.condition_definition: Conditions are exposure-based at target-visit level and may overlap. visible means at least one clear frame; needle_occluded means at least one partial/full needle-occlusion frame; other_visibility_issue means target absent even with the needle hidden; unknown means visibility could not be classified.
target_success_by_visibility.exclusive_visit_class_definition: An auxiliary single-label summary prioritizes needle_occluded, then other_visibility_issue, then visible when every sampled frame is clear, otherwise unknown. It is not used for condition_exposure success rates; exposure groups may overlap.
target_success_by_visibility.source: frame visibility labels from MuJoCo segmentation plus per-waypoint endpoint and stop reports

stop_constraint_summary.stop_validation_source: per-target controller stop reports or rest-to-rest planner endpoints; final command velocity must be zero
